papers.title: RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting
papers.what: Splits the amplitude spectrum and routes dominant periodicities to a phase-preserving complex linear predictor in the frequency domain while returning residual energy to a lightweight time-domain MLP, giving the best average MSE on six of eight benchmarks and best MSE and MAE at both extremes, the highly non-stationary COVID-19 set and the strongly periodic Solar set.

papers.title: ReasonCast: Towards Explainable Time Series Forecasting with Reasoning
papers.what: Fine-tunes any LLM backbone to emit a reasoning chain and a numeric forecast in one autoregressive pass, and releases ReasonTS-Bench, which scores forecast MAE alongside three reasoning metrics averaged over five time-series pattern primitives.
papers.builds_on: ChatTS (2025, VSCNJG5J); TS-Agent (2025, I2CIT4I7); Chain-of-Thought (2023, HBLPTRMY)

papers.title: FOUND-AF: Benchmarking ECG Foundation Models for Atrial Fibrillation Detection
papers.what: Runs nine public ECG foundation models from five families across four datasets as frozen feature extractors with a fixed XGBoost head and recording-level grouped cross-validation, so the ranking measures representation quality rather than fine-tuning effort, with ECGFounder strongest overall.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals Survey (2025, 2XWEG7AF); HeAR (2024, 3LA8GNCU); SSL for HAR 700K Person-days (2024, RTMH75VW)

papers.title: WIRED: Weighted Adaptive Prediction with Structured Dependence for Probabilistic Multiseries Forecasting
papers.what: Separates marginal calibration from cross-series dependence by combining simple predictive distributions with CRPS-adaptive mixture weights and reconstructing dependence afterwards with a Gaussian or Student t copula, so no property of the marginal objective can destroy the joint structure.
papers.builds_on: Forecast Collapse in TSFMs (2026, 2608.14106); Cross Variable Loss (2026, 2608.05742)
